latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Compressor for GitHub.
- Enables quick compression of large video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) with simple instructions.
- Built-in automatic setup and cloud video processing; no coding required.
- Supports session management, credit checks, error handling, and user prompts for export, upload, and video edits.
- Fast export: typically delivers a compressed 1080p MP4 in 30–90 seconds per video.
- Comprehensive support for common video and audio file types, with clear error messages and workflow tips.
